# **Welcome\!**

# **This document is the main source of information regarding nohits, providing lots of useful information and tips.**

Our goal with this document is to define a standard for a particular way to enjoy the game, giving a chance for people to attempt, discuss, and compare similar experiences  — the main objective is to have fun\!

We have a Discord server for our community which can provide additional help beyond the guidance of the document: a bot that allows you to look up submitted nohits for any boss on any difficulty is available, as well as plenty of active veterans that you can ask for advice directly. 

The server also doubles as a fun place to relax, have nice conversations in, or generally hang out in, thanks to plenty of channels unrelated to nohits.

If you’d like to join, simply forward a playlist containing nohits of any 13 bosses (equal to the number of bosses in Pre-Hardmode) to one of the following staff members:

**@nyastra   @ben\_tk   @omegafumo   @congratsistrash   @gpscorpion**   

**@riz30n014   @sirscorepan   @pineytea   @bronzeckn**

Alternatively, the procedure is also outlined in [this other Discord server](https://discord.gg/U5SqnqqRPx), which mirrors this document. You will easily find the staff members in the sidebar.

If you have no intention of finishing a journey, please don't do the minimum amount of nohits just to join the server; instead, message one of the staff members mentioned above and tell them why you wish to be invited.

All changes made to the nohit rules are documented in the above-mentioned Discord servers. It’s recommended to be in at least one of them to remain updated.

Furthermore, if you have any questions about nohitting that aren’t answered here, feel free to ask any of the staff members.

# **Introduction and Summary**

Starting a journey might seem intimidating due to the large amount of content present both in-game and in this document, that’s why we’re providing a brief summary to ease you into everything and let you know what you can expect from this challenge: 

* Your items must not be from other mods, and they have to follow progression — unless it’s something that does not affect the fight, like vanity.  
* You have to play in singleplayer.  
* You cannot cheese the bosses or abuse frameskip/pauses.  
* Using I-frames from actions considered rams or bonks is allowed; however, passing through bosses or projectiles with parries, *Black Belt*\-like dodges, or any other sources of I-frames is prohibited.  
* Your arenas must be a reasonable size.  
* You may not use other mods to modify the functionality of buffs, items or game mechanics (See sections 4).  
* Nohits must be uploaded to YouTube.  
* Rapid movement through the use of *Teleporters*, portals, hoiks, or similar is not allowed.  
* Your visible area cannot exceed what you see with a 1920x1080 resolution.  
* The nohit should be above the minimum length and follow boss-specific rulings (See sections 6/7).  
* If the rules or the mod get updated in a way that would affect the bossfight before you’ve uploaded your video, it will be considered out-of-date and get disqualified.  
* In-game sound must be audible at all times.

We highly encourage you to read the rest of the document for an exhaustive list, it has been meticulously polished throughout the years thanks to efforts by the community and with it we hope to be as clear as possible so that everything feels fair. 

Most of the details are there to address edge cases, patch loopholes or simply clarify things, as such, we hope you will find most of it to be common sense.

Lastly**,** judges may allow for some leniency in the case of mishaps — this doesn't mean you can break the rules, it just means if you do make a minor error, your nohit may not be instantly disqualified. If you realize you’ve messed up, it might be worth asking for someone else’s opinion before discarding the attempt.

## **Section 1: Nohit Journeys and Difficulties**

**Important: Nohit roles are no longer obtainable in the official Calamity Mod Discord. However, you are still encouraged to join our server if you plan on nohitting.**

* You may have any number of journeys active at any time.  
* You have to play in singleplayer.  
* You may freely switch between Expert, Master, and Legendary.  
  * Legendary difficulty may only be achieved through the use of the “for the worthy” seed, not the “get fixed boi” seed.  
* Nohits are reviewed with the criteria of the journey they are submitted in; self-imposed restrictions will not be accounted for when determining whether the nohit reaches the minimum requirements needed for it to be verified.  
  * For example, you may freely submit a **Defiled** nohit for a non-**Defiled** journey, it will however be treated as a non-**Defiled** nohit for that specific journey.  
* If your journey has not been completed yet and a new boss is released, you will have to nohit them in order to get your role.  
* Your nohits will generally only be reviewed if they are part of a journey that has the potential of awarding a role you don’t already possess.  
  * For example, if you've already completed a **Revengeance**\-**Defiled** journey and attempt to submit a **Revengeance** journey, it will not be reviewed under normal circumstances.

### **Core Difficulties**

The base modes in which every nohit will take place, selectable through the difficulty indicator interface.

**Nohit every boss in Revengeance mode**

#### **Postmortal** **![][image3]**

**Nohit every boss in Death mode**

#### **Hellforged** **![][image4]**

**Nohit every boss in Infernum mode**

### **Modifiers**

As these are modifiers and not standalone difficulties, the only way to obtain these roles is by adding them on top of an existing nohit journey. 

* You may not mix nohits done on different Core Difficulties to earn the roles.  
* You can earn multiple roles at the same time by stacking modifiers in a single journey.

#### **Fallen Angel** **![][image5]**

**Nohit every boss with wing flight disabled**

* Commonly referred to as “**Defiled**”, named after the item that originally introduced this effect, the *Defiled Rune*.  
* You can disable flight through the usage of mods such as **Nycro’s Nohit Efficiency Mod**.

#### **Blazing Iris** **![][image6]**

**Nohit every boss with the *Odd Mushroom* effect active**

* Permits and requires the use of the *Odd Mushroom* item in Pre-Hardmode.  
* Commonly referred to as simply “**Shroom**”.

Note that there are multiple versions of the visual effect available, you may use whichever you prefer and also switch between them at will to complete a **Shroom** journey.

* Using the *Odd Mushroom* item present in the mod multiple times will strengthen its effects twice, for a total of 3 possible variants.  
* **Imogen’s QoL Mod** adds the *Nostalgic Shroom* item, meant to mimic the old visual effect; as well as the *Double Shroom* item, which doubles the strength of said effect.

### **Extra**

As these are meant to be standalone challenges and not proper journeys, they will not award other roles regardless of Core Difficulty or modifiers chosen.

## **Section 2: Equipment and Power-ups**

* Your gear must be from either **Calamity** or **Vanilla.**  
  * You may use items from other mods if explicitly allowed or if they are confirmed to have no effect on the nohit (refer to Section 4 for more information).  
  * You may only use **Infernum** gear during an **Infernum** journey.  
* You must only use gear, items, buffs, or power-ups available before the bosses you’re nohitting, unless explicitly stated otherwise or if they have no effect on the nohit.  
  * For example, if you’re trying to nohit *Plantera*, you must use Pre-*Plantera* gear only.  
  * Be careful not to accidentally use scaling items, such as *The Community,* scaled past your point of progression.  
  * Make sure you have not used permanent power-ups, such as *Mana*, *Adrenaline*, or *Rage* upgrades, past your point of progression, unless they have no effect on the nohit.  
    * *Life* upgrades are allowed, as long as they have no discernible effect on a nohit.  
    * *Mana* upgrades are allowed if you are not using any items that interact with *Mana*.  
    * *Adrenaline* or *Rage* upgrades are allowed if you have not activated either damage boost in your nohit.  
* You may use the extra accessory slot provided by Master Mode.  
* It is recommended to keep a *Gold* or *Platinum Watch*, as well as a *DPS meter* (or their upgrades), in your inventory at all times during nohits.  
* It is highly recommended to show all items and gear used for a nohit in the video. Writing it down in the description or a comment if you forgot is acceptable — although not preferred.  
* Utilizing mounts is allowed, but be mindful of their use, as they might prove too strong.  
  * In particular, usage of the *Exo Box* mount is discouraged.  
* Losing HP from negative life regeneration (from Alcohols, *Mana Polarizer*, etc.) or directly losing it from *Astral Injection* is allowed.  
* Dodges from items such as the *Counter Scarf*, *Hallowed Armor,* and similar are not allowed.  
  * The best way to ensure safety is to enable the instant death configuration option in **Nycro’s Nohit Efficiency Mod** (refer to Section 4 or find it on the mod browser), which disables all dodges but keeps bonks and rams.  
* Bonking something with the *Shield of Cthulhu*, *Phosphorescent Gauntlet,* or ramming with *Ornate Shield* or its upgrades is allowed.  
* Using the *God Slayer Armor*’s dash is allowed, but dodging through a projectile with it will disqualify your nohit.  
* Similarly, using *Old Lord Claymore*, *The Final Dawn*, or the *Ark* line’s parries to pass through bosses or projectiles is not allowed.  
* It does not matter how you obtain the items used in your nohits, as long as you are using them at the correct progression point.

These things are allowed even if normally not obtainable at that point of progression (or if from other mods):

* Vanity items.  
* Pets.  
* Light Pets (within reason).  
* Extra accessory slots, if they have no effect on the fight.  
* Accessories that are confirmed to have no effect on the fight.  
  * For example, an accessory that only gives building speed.  
* Items in inventory that have no function.  
* *Zen Potion* or any other means to disable or reduce spawns.  
* Any food item that provides the *Well Fed*, *Plenty Satisfied,* or *Exquisitely Stuffed* buffs.  
* The *Odd Mushroom*, specifically if doing a complete **Shroom** journey, is allowed even in Pre-Hardmode, otherwise it remains locked to Hardmode.

## **Section 3: World and Arenas**

**If you’d like to build your own nohit worlds and arenas, keep the following in mind:**

* Actuators are not allowed Pre-*Skeletron* as they’re not available until then, unless they have no effect on the fight (e.g. boss fights that have no biome requirements).  
* There is not a fixed limitation for arena sizes but it is advised to be mindful of the amount of space used in a fight, especially with earlier bosses. If the size or any elements of the arena notably cause parts of the boss to be invalidated, then it may result in the nohit being disqualified.   
  * It is highly encouraged to keep *Exo Mechs* nohits to only the surface layer, as more vertical space than that can easily trivialize the fight.  
* Usage of *teleporters*, portals, hoiks, and other modes of rapid movement are not allowed. If you're unsure whether or not something falls into this category, either ask one of the judges or play it safe and don't use it.  
* If you want to modify *The Lost Colosseum* or *The Profaned Garden* in an **Infernum** journey, make sure to stick to modifications that are possible without external tools or mods.


**If you’d rather use a pre-built world tailored for nohitting, consider downloading [Elysium](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1DrZbK-TXZK8Dcj9KtIPODTcDQ9wwH0ID/view), made by @nyastra.**

* Requires **Hero’s Mod** & **Fargo’s Mutant Mod**, or/and **Imogen’s QoL Mod** & **Imogen’s QoL: Calamity**.  
* Huge world arena made with hammered platforms.  
  * Since the world is designed to be utilized for the entire journey, make sure to still use an appropriate amount of space for each individual boss.  
* Dedicated arenas for bosses that require them, such as *Wall of Flesh*, *Golem*, or *Polterghast*.  
  * In particular, *Supreme Witch, Calamitas* arenas featuring different sizes for each difficulty, as well as the choice between rail or rope filled variants.  
* Biome toggles for the various arenas, located in the world’s spawn area.  
* Dedicated building filled with gear loadouts for every boss in **Vanilla** & **Calamity**.

**To install, download the files and put them into your worlds folder (Documents/My Games/Terraria/tModloader/Worlds), then reload the world selection menu.**

## **Section 4: Other Mods**

**You may use features from mods other than Calamity, Calamity Music, and Infernum, if they are explicitly allowed or if they have no effect on the nohits.**

**Be mindful of possible bugs introduced by all mods.**

To begin with, here are some widely used mods that were either made with nohits in mind or are very convenient for players and judges alike.

[**Nycro’s Nohit Efficiency Mod**](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2819498996) (Made by @nycro)

A versatile, lightweight, and highly configurable mod with quality of life and performance additions.

* Enable instant death when getting hit, including attacks that trigger effects similar to the *Black Belt*.  
* Despawn entities on death, such as bosses, projectiles, dust, and more.  
* Disable rain, events, fallen stars, and tombstones.  
* Automatic deletion of pickup hearts, mana stars, and ground items.  
* Show various fight statistics for each attempt, such as attempt number, remaining boss health, fight length, and slowdown percentage.  
* Respawn timer and HP override.  
* Toggleable unlimited consumables, ammo, potions, and more.  
* Allows capping gore and dust lifetimes for reduced lag.  
* Allows flight time to be disabled.

[**Imogen’s QoL Mod**](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2993809064) & [**Imogen's QoL: Calamity**](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2993809175) (Made by @imogen10, maintained by @midnight295)

Another quality of life mod with some feature overlap but also some more in-depth features.

* Adds several boss summons, including ones that can spawn up to 10x of each boss simultaneously.  
*  Adds the *Nostalgic Mushroom*, a variant of the *Odd Mushroom* meant to mimic its old visual effect; as well as the *Double Mushroom*, which doubles the strength of these effects.  
* Various toggles located in an interface near the minimap, like instant death, potion effects, or the death state of any boss.  
* Adds a summoner minion slot counter.  
* Adds the *Shiny Wand* and the *Reflective Wand*, items that let you spawn a simulation of *Calamitas Clone*’s and *Supreme Witch, Calamitas*’ bullet hells, respectively.  
* Adds the *Potion of Rage*, which gives you max *Rage* for 2 seconds if no boss is alive.

These next tools, while very convenient, can be misleading in the case of bugs or if they haven’t yet been fully updated; as such, please take care when relying on them. If you find any issues, report them to the mod’s maintainer.

* Automated permanent power-up management, to avoid using off-tier ones.  
* Chat messages that inform you if you were under Minimum Nohit Length for a boss fight, and by how much.  
* Toggles to lock off-tier weapons, potions, and accessories.

**To continue, here are some guidelines for all other mods.**

* You may use mods that give you infinite potion buff duration.  
  * You may not, however, use potions that combine different effects into a single buff slot.  
* You may not increase the amount of buff slots available to you or reduce the amount of buff slots taken up by existing buffs.  
  * For example, **LuiAFK**’s custom unlimited buff potions do not take up a buff slot.  
* You may not use mods that give you the *Happy* buff without having to place down *Sunflowers*.  
* You may use the **Better Zoom** mod to increase your available resolution up to the maximum of 1920x1080.  
  * Refer to Section 5 for more details.  
* You may use boss cursor effects from mods such as **Boss Checklist**.  
  * Be careful when using these during a **Shroom** nohit; as visibility is a large part of the challenge, they may be grounds for disqualification if deemed too influential.  
* You may use items and blocks from other mods, as long as they don’t have any properties that would meaningfully affect the fight.  
  * For example, you may freely use **Fargo’s Mutant Mod**’s biome-changing fountains Pre-*Skeletron*, as long as the boss you’re fighting is not affected by the selected biome.  
* You may pause time through mods like **HERO’s Mod**.  
* You may reduce or even completely disable natural enemy spawns.  
* Lighthack effects are not allowed.  
* *Rod of Discord* hotkeys are not allowed.  
* Mods that change the properties or stats of weapons, such as **Omniswing**, are not allowed.

## **Section 5: In-game Settings**

* The visible area must not exceed what you can see with a 1920x1080 in-game resolution. If yours is bigger, you should use the zoom feature to bring the visible playing field to be as close as possible to the required size; if it’s smaller, you may use mods like [**Better Zoom**](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2562953970) to zoom out.  
  * Your zoom can be calculated by dividing your screen’s height by 1080, then rounding up if necessary.  
    * As an example, for a 1360x768 in-game resolution, this would yield (768/1080) \= 0.711 or 71% zoom. A resolution of 2160x1440p would instead calculate as 133% zoom.  
* Sound effects must be audible at all times.   
  * Music can be freely turned off.  
* It’s helpful to enable Terraria’s FPS counter using (Fn+)F10  
* You cannot abuse frameskip settings to slow down the game excessively, whether intentionally or unintentionally, although some leniency is given out when lag is unavoidable due to hardware limitations.  
  * If you're having performance issues, refer to the Extra Section.  
* Auto-pause should be disabled, although tabbing out for a moment is alright — as long as it is not excessive.

## **Section 6: Boss Fight Guidelines**

**Bosses grouped together with a black outline are considered interchangeable in progression; this means you can choose in which order to challenge them, and use gear from the ones you’ve defeated against those remaining in the same tier (Example: Mechanical bosses).** 

**If they’re grouped together with a red outline, they are not considered interchangeable and you may simply choose which one to do first, without using one’s gear against the other (Example: *Eater of Worlds* and *Brain of Cthulhu*).**

* The length of each nohit should be equal or longer than the Minimum Nohit Length guideline (MNL) displayed under each boss.  
  * Artificially inflating the length of the nohit to match the time limit by intentionally stalling in easy phases of the fight *will* be noticed and will likely result in your nohit getting disqualified.  
  * The numbers next to the times have the following meanings:  
    * \[1\] Includes spawn animation.  
    * \[2\] Excludes spawn animation.  
    * \[3\] Includes death animation.  
    * \[4\] Includes Acceptance phase.

## **Section 7: Infernum Boss Fight Guidelines**

**Bosses grouped together with a black outline are considered interchangeable in progression; this means you can choose in which order to challenge them, and use gear from the ones you’ve defeated against those remaining in the same tier (Example: Mechanical bosses).** 

**If they’re grouped together with a red outline, they are not considered interchangeable and you may simply choose which one to do first, without using one’s gear against the other (Example: *Eater of Worlds* and *Brain of Cthulhu*).**

* The length of each nohit should be equal or longer than the Minimum Nohit Length guideline (MNL) displayed under each boss.  
  * Artificially inflating the length of the nohit to match the time limit by intentionally stalling in easy phases of the fight *will* be noticed and will likely result in your nohit getting disqualified.  
  * The numbers next to the times have the following meanings:  
    * \[1\] Includes spawn animation.  
    * \[2\] Excludes spawn animation.  
    * \[3\] Includes death animation.  
    * \[4\] The MNL timer starts as soon as the *Holy Shield*’s HP in the first phase (Fire Walls) reaches 0\.  
    * \[5\] MNL timer ends as soon as the Terminus appears.

## **Section 8: Recording and Uploading**

All nohits must be uploaded to YouTube; it is recommended to do so as soon as possible, since uploading a nohit after an update that would have affected it (such as AI changes, gear nerfs, or boss health buffs), will cause it to be considered out of date and get disqualified.  
Everything is based on the date the YouTube video is uploaded.

**Note:** If a video’s shown date has changed, you may restore the original upload date by switching back to the original visibility setting.

You may submit moderately edited footage; however, it is always recommended to also upload the raw footage, even as unlisted, then put the link to it in the submitted video’s description or comments.

### **Recording Options**

* [OBS](https://obsproject.com/)  
* [Shadowplay](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/geforce/geforce-experience/shadowplay/)\*  
* [Xbox Game Bar](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/use-a-screen-reader-to-record-your-screen-with-xbox-game-bar-5328cd25-9046-4472-8a14-c485f138802c)\*  
  * Built into Windows and opened by pressing Windows \+ G.

### **Video Editing Options**

* [LosslessCut](https://github.com/mifi/lossless-cut#download)  
  * Must download the executables manually from GitHub, otherwise it's not free.  
* [Shotcut](https://shotcut.org/)  
* [ClipChamp](https://clipchamp.com/en/)\*  
  * Requires Google Chrome/Microsoft Edge.  
* [Windows Photos App](https://www.businessinsider.com/how-to-trim-videos-on-windows)\*  
  * Built into Windows and very simplistic.  
  * Caps FPS of clips at 30\.  
* [DaVinci Resolve](https://www.blackmagicdesign.com/products/davinciresolve/)  
  * Very overkill for just trimming videos but good if you plan to do some advanced video editing.

**\***Only works on Windows

Additionally, here are [YouTube's recommended encoding settings for uploads](https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/1722171?hl=en#zippy=).

## **Extra: Dealing with Lag**

### **In-Game**

* Using less laggy weapons/gear is the easiest fix.  
* Remove background walls.  
* Don't fight things underground as rendering the underground background seems to produce lag.  
* Set your lighting to retro or white.  
* Turn all quality settings to low in the video settings.  
* Turn off afterimages in **Calamity**'s configuration options.  
* Use [**Nycro's Nohit Efficiency Mod**](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2819498996), which has some amazing anti-lag features.  
* Use the [**Optimizerraria**](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2447428824) texture pack.  
* Reduce your resolution or don't use **BetterZoom**.

### **Out of game**

* Turn off all other apps that can be closed, for example, Discord and Chrome tabs that are taking up memory (use shift+esc for the Chrome task manager so you can see what tabs use the most).  
* Reduce the quality of the recording by lowering resolution, bitrate, or FPS.  
  * Lossier compression may also help, although this will result in larger file sizes.  
  * Make sure the recording is still of acceptable quality (at least 360p) for submission.  
* If you have it set up but are using something else to record, disable Windows capture's clip feature.  
* If your video has unusual chops and skips, try setting the target of the recording’s save to a faster drive if you have it.

### **If you still have lag issues**

* Change frame skip to subtle or off; this will put your nohit under more attentive scrutiny the slower it becomes.  
  * Use **Imogen’s QoL Mod** or enable the slowdown percentage feature in **Nycro’s Nohit Efficiency Mod** so judges can gauge how much the game has slowed down.  
    * Generally, the slowdown percentage should not be below 75%.  
    * If you can't do the above, then using an accessory that displays time — with time unfrozen — will also work.
